<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Web Platform & Tooling — Interview Prep</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400&family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500..800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* study-theme v4 "whiteboard": the one stylesheet every guide uses. Edit here, then run
     `npm run study:upgrade` to apply it to every guide (lib.upgrade swaps each guide's <style> for this file).
     Token names are also used inside the SVG diagrams (dg*.mjs), so rename none of them. */
  :root{
    /* light: a whiteboard. Navy ink, blue marker for actions, green for done, yellow highlighter. */
    --bg:#F5F7FA;
    --panel:#FFFFFF;
    --panel-2:#EEF2F7;
    --border:#D3DAE5;
    --text:#14213D;
    --muted:#4F5D78;
    --accent:#1B55C5;
    --accent-ink:#FFFFFF;
    --accent-soft:#E4EDFC;
    --gold:#7A5200;
    --gold-soft:#FFF1B8;
    --ok:#126B4B;
    --ok-soft:#DDF3E9;
    --code-bg:#EEF2F7;
    --danger:#B42318;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,33,61,.06), 0 4px 14px rgba(20,33,61,.04);
    --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    --sans: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    --display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', var(--sans);
    --measure: 76ch;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      /* dark: a chalkboard. Chalk white text, chalk blue / yellow / green accents. */
      --bg:#101A19;
      --panel:#17231F;
      --panel-2:#1E2D29;
      --border:#33493F;
      --text:#ECF1EE;
      --muted:#A9B8B1;
      --accent:#93BCFF;
      --accent-ink:#0A1730;
      --accent-soft:#1D3048;
      --gold:#F0CF6B;
      --gold-soft:#3A3216;
      --ok:#7FD6A8;
      --ok-soft:#173327;
      --code-bg:#0C1513;
      --danger:#F5A99C;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#101A19;
    --panel:#17231F;
    --panel-2:#1E2D29;
    --border:#33493F;
    --text:#ECF1EE;
    --muted:#A9B8B1;
    --accent:#93BCFF;
    --accent-ink:#0A1730;
    --accent-soft:#1D3048;
    --gold:#F0CF6B;
    --gold-soft:#3A3216;
    --ok:#7FD6A8;
    --ok-soft:#173327;
    --code-bg:#0C1513;
    --danger:#F5A99C;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  html{color-scheme:light dark; scroll-padding-top:16px;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  }
  a{color:var(--accent); text-underline-offset:2px;}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px;}
  ::selection{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text);}

  .app{display:flex; min-height:100vh;}

  /* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
  .sidebar{
    width:288px;
    flex:0 0 288px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--panel);
    padding:18px 14px 24px;
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    height:100vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:thin;
  }
  .side-top{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin:0 0 14px;}
  .home-link{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:8px;}
  .home-link:hover{color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .theme-btn{font:inherit; font-size:15px; line-height:1; width:34px; height:34px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;}
  .theme-btn:hover{color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent);}
  .brand{
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.45;
    color:var(--muted);
    padding:0 8px 16px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .brand b{display:block; font-family:var(--display); font-size:19px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--text);}
  .brand br{display:none;}
  .nav-item{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:10px;
    width:100%;
    text-align:left;
    padding:9px 10px;
    border-radius:9px;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.35;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{background:var(--panel-2);}
  .nav-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text); font-weight:700; box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);}
  .nav-num{font-size:12.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); width:20px; flex:0 0 20px;}
  .nav-item.active .nav-num{color:var(--accent);}
  .nav-label{flex:1;}
  .nav-count{
    font-size:12px;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:1px 7px;
    border-radius:999px;
  }
  .nav-item.complete .nav-count{color:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft);}
  .progress-box{
    margin-top:20px;
    padding:14px 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    background:var(--panel-2);
  }
  .progress-box .label{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; text-transform:lowercase;}
  .progress-box .label::first-letter{text-transform:uppercase;}
  .progress-track{height:8px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--border); overflow:hidden;}
  .progress-fill{height:100%; background:var(--ok); width:0%; transition:width .25s ease;}
  .progress-num{margin-top:8px; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text);}
  .reset-btn{
    margin-top:10px;
    width:100%;
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:7px 8px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .reset-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);border-color:var(--danger);}

  /* ---------- Main ---------- */
  .main{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
    padding:40px 48px 96px;
    max-width:1080px;
  }
  .hero{margin-bottom:36px;}
  .hero .eyebrow-free{display:none;}
  .hero h1{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
    line-height:1.12;
    margin:0 0 14px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
    text-wrap:balance;
  }
  .hero p{color:var(--muted); max-width:68ch; margin:0 0 6px; font-size:16.5px;}
  .hero p strong{color:var(--text);}
  .hero .source-note{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:18px; line-height:1.9;}

  .section-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:12px;
    margin:44px 0 14px;
    padding-bottom:12px;
    border-bottom:2px solid var(--text);
  }
  .section-head .num{font-family:var(--display); color:var(--accent); font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .section-head h2{font-family:var(--display); font-size:26px; line-height:1.2; margin:0; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.015em;}
  .section-head .count{margin-left:auto; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap;}

  .qcard{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:14px;
    background:var(--panel);
    margin-bottom:10px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .qcard:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .qcard.open{border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent), var(--shadow);}
  .qcard.focused{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qhead{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:14px;
    padding:15px 18px;
    cursor:pointer;
    user-select:none;
  }
  .qcheck{
    margin-top:3px;
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:20px;height:20px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--muted);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:var(--panel);
  }
  .qcheck:hover{border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done{background:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done::after{content:"✓"; color:var(--panel); font-size:13px; font-weight:700;}
  .qmain{flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px;}
  .qtext{flex:1; font-size:16.5px; line-height:1.4; font-weight:700;}
  .qtext.done-text{color:var(--muted); font-weight:500;}
  .qchips{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .qsec,.qcore{font-size:12px; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted); background:var(--panel-2);}
  .qcore{color:var(--gold); border-color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft);}
  .qsum{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qcard.open .qsum{display:none;}
  .qchevron{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;
    transform:rotate(0deg);
    transition:transform .15s ease;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .qcard.open .qchevron{transform:rotate(90deg); color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody{
    display:none;
    padding:2px 22px 22px 52px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.65;
  }
  .qcard.open .qbody{display:block; padding-top:18px;}
  /* Prose keeps a readable line length; tables, code and diagrams may use the full card width. */
  .qbody > p, .qbody > ul, .qbody > ol, .qbody > blockquote, .qbody > .callout, .qbody > h3, .qbody > h4{max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qbody p{margin:0 0 14px;}
  .qbody ul, .qbody ol{margin:0 0 14px; padding-left:22px;}
  .qbody li{margin-bottom:7px;}
  .qbody li::marker{color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody strong{color:var(--text); font-weight:700;}
  .qbody h3, .qbody h4{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; margin:20px 0 8px; letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  code{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:0 5px;
    border-radius:5px;
    font-size:0.875em;
    overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  }
  pre{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    color:var(--text);
    padding:14px 16px;
    border-radius:10px;
    overflow-x:auto;
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.65;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    tab-size:2;
  }
  pre code{background:none; border:0; padding:0; font-size:inherit;}
  /* syntax colouring added by the engine (comments, strings, keywords, numbers) */
  .tk-c{color:var(--muted); font-style:italic;}
  .tk-s{color:var(--ok);}
  .tk-k{color:var(--accent); font-weight:500;}
  .tk-n{color:var(--gold);}
  .diagram{
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:16px;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    overflow-x:auto;
  }
  .diagram svg{display:block; margin:0 auto; max-width:100%; height:auto;}
  .diagram.lightbg{background:#F8FAFC; border-color:#CBD5E1;}
  .diagram.lightbg .codelabel{color:#334155;}
  .tag{
    display:inline-block;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--gold);
    background:var(--gold-soft);
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:1px 7px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .tscroll{overflow-x:auto; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .tscroll > table.cmp{margin:0;}
  table.cmp{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    font-size:14.5px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  table.cmp th, table.cmp td{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:9px 12px;
    text-align:left;
    vertical-align:top;
  }
  table.cmp th{background:var(--panel-2); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;}
  table.cmp tr:nth-child(odd) td{background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 45%, transparent);}

  .tbadge{display:inline-block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft); border:1px solid var(--gold); border-radius:99px; padding:2px 10px; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .deeper{margin-top:16px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.9;}
  .deeper + .deeper{margin-top:2px; padding-top:0; border-top:0;}
  a.go{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);}
  a.go:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--accent);}

  .search{width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; margin:0 0 14px; padding:10px 12px; font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--bg); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;}
  .search::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}
  .search:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qcheck:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px;}
  mark{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text); border-radius:3px; padding:0 2px;}
  .toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:10px 16px; margin:0 0 18px; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .toolbar .tmeta{font-size:13.5px; margin-right:auto;}
  .toolbar .tgroup{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .toolbar button{font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 12px; cursor:pointer;}
  .toolbar button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent);}
  .toolbar label{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;}
  .toolbar input{accent-color:var(--accent); width:15px; height:15px;}
  .empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; padding:18px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px;}
  .pager{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:28px;}
  .pager button{font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--accent); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; cursor:pointer; max-width:48%; text-align:left;}
  .pager button:last-child{text-align:right;}
  .pager button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .back-btn{position:fixed; right:22px; bottom:22px; z-index:10; font:inherit; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:0; border-radius:99px; padding:11px 18px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
  .keys{display:inline-block; margin-top:6px;}
  kbd{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:0 5px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-bottom-width:2px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--panel); color:var(--text);}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:18px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}
  .fc-start,.toolbar .flash-btn{font:inherit; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-start{font-size:15px; padding:10px 18px;}
  .toolbar .flash-btn{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .toolbar .flash-btn:hover{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .fc-start:hover,.toolbar .flash-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);}
  button.fc-start.alt{background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}
  button.fc-start.alt:hover{background:var(--accent-soft); filter:none;}
  a.fc-start.alt{display:inline-block; text-decoration:none; background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}

  /* ---------- Flashcards ---------- */
  body.fc-lock{overflow:hidden;}
  .fc{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; background:rgba(8,14,26,.6); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px;}
  .fc[hidden]{display:none;}
  .fc-dialog{width:min(920px,100%); max-height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4); outline:none;}
  .fc-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:18px 22px 12px;}
  .fc-title{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; font-weight:700;}
  .fc-count{font-size:13px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px;}
  .fc-tools{display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .fc-tools label{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-tools input{accent-color:var(--accent);}
  .fc-tools button{font:inherit; font-size:15px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; width:34px; height:34px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-bar{height:5px; background:var(--border); margin:0 22px; border-radius:99px; overflow:hidden;}
  .fc-bar i{display:block; height:100%; width:0; background:var(--ok); transition:width .2s ease;}
  .fc-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:24px 26px; min-height:220px;}
  .fc-q{font-family:var(--display); font-size:25px; line-height:1.3; margin:12px 0 18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.015em; text-wrap:balance;}
  .fc-prompt{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:28px 18px; text-align:center;}
  .fc .qbody.fc-a{display:block; border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding:18px 0 0; font-size:16px;}
  .fc-done h3{font-family:var(--display); font-size:22px; margin:0 0 8px;}
  .fc-done .fc-sub{color:var(--muted); margin:14px 0 6px;}
  .fc-done ul{padding-left:20px; font-size:15px;}
  .fc-actions{display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:flex-end; padding:14px 22px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .fc-actions button{font:inherit; font-size:15px; color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 18px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-actions button.primary{color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); font-weight:700;}
  .fc-actions button.again{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold);}
  .fc-actions button:first-child{margin-right:auto;}
  .fc-actions kbd{margin-left:6px; background:transparent; border-color:currentColor; color:inherit; opacity:.8;}
  .fc-keys{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); padding:0 22px 16px; text-align:right;}

  /* ---------- Answer building blocks ---------- */
  .lede{font-size:17px; color:var(--text); font-weight:500;}
  .callout{background:var(--accent-soft); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); border-left:4px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .callout.warning{background:var(--gold-soft); border-color:var(--gold);}
  .callout > :last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .note{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .codelabel{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); margin:12px 0 5px;}
  .verified{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); border-top:1px dashed var(--border); padding-top:8px; margin-top:12px;}
  .verified strong{color:var(--accent);}
  .keyline{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--accent);}
  .followup{border-left:3px solid var(--gold); padding-left:12px; color:var(--text);}
  .gcards{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .gcard{border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; background:var(--panel-2); padding:14px 16px;}
  .gcard h3,.gcard h4{margin:0 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-family:var(--sans);}
  .gcard ul{margin:0; padding-left:18px;}
  .rail{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin:0 0 16px; font-size:14px;}
  .rail span{background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px;}
  .rail span b{display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--accent);}

The attacker uses your server's network position to reach things they cannot: internal services and cloud metadata endpoints such as <code>http://169.254.169.254/</code>, which can hand out cloud credentials.</p><ul><li><strong>Allowlist</strong> the hosts or domains a feature may call; do not try to blocklist bad ones.</li><li><strong>Resolve DNS yourself, check the IP</strong> against private, loopback and link-local ranges, then connect to that IP (defeats DNS rebinding).       q:"How should passwords be stored?",
      a:`<ul><li><strong>Use a slow, memory-hard password hash.</strong> OWASP's order of preference: <strong>Argon2id</strong> (at least 19 MiB memory, 2 iterations, 1 degree of parallelism), then <strong>scrypt</strong> if Argon2id is unavailable, <strong>bcrypt</strong> only for legacy systems (work factor 10 or more, and it ignores anything past 72 bytes), and <strong>PBKDF2</strong> (600,000+ iterations with HMAC-SHA-256) when FIPS compliance is required. Never MD5, SHA-1 or plain SHA-256: they are built to be fast.</li><li><strong>A unique salt per password</strong> (the library generates and stores it) so identical passwords hash differently and rainbow tables are useless.</li><li><strong>Tune the cost</strong> so a login takes tens to hundreds of milliseconds on your hardware, and raise it over time; re-hash on successful login when parameters are outdated.</li><li><strong>A pepper</strong> (a secret kept outside the database, for example in a key manager) is optional defence in depth; OWASP notes it adds nothing on its own.</li><li>Compare with the library's verify function (constant time), rate-limit login attempts, and prefer passkeys or SSO where you can.</li><li>Never log or email passwords; reset with expiring single-use tokens.</li></ul><pre>import argon2 from 'argon2';

const hash = await argon2.hash(password);              // argon2id by default, salt included in the string
const ok = await argon2.verify(hash, attemptedPassword);
if (ok && argon2.needsRehash(hash)) await save(await argon2.hash(attemptedPassword));</pre><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Encryption is not hashing: passwords are never decrypted, only verified.</p>`

      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th>Directive / header</th><th>Meaning</th></tr><tr><td><code>max-age=N</code></td><td>fresh for N seconds; the browser uses it without asking the server</td></tr><tr><td><code>s-maxage=N</code></td><td>like max-age but only for shared caches (CDN)</td></tr><tr><td><code>no-cache</code></td><td><strong>store it, but revalidate before use</strong> (not "do not cache")</td></tr><tr><td><code>no-store</code></td><td>do not store at all (sensitive data)</td></tr><tr><td><code>immutable</code></td><td>never revalidate while fresh: for fingerprinted files such as <code>app.9f3a.js</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>stale-while-revalidate=N</code></td><td>serve the stale copy for N more seconds while refreshing in the background</td></tr><tr><td><code>ETag</code> + <code>If-None-Match</code></td><td>conditional request: the server answers <strong>304 Not Modified</strong> with no body if unchanged</td></tr><tr><td><code>Vary: Accept-Encoding</code></td><td>the cache key includes that request header</td></tr></table><pre># hashed build assets: cache for a year

Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300</pre><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> The standard strategy: <strong>long-lived immutable URLs for assets, short or revalidated caching for HTML and APIs</strong>. Changing the filename (a content hash) is how you invalidate.</p>`

  e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then((keys) => Promise.all(keys.filter((k) => k !== CACHE).map((k) => caches.delete(k)))));
});
self.addEventListener('fetch', (e) => {
  e.respondWith(caches.match(e.request).then((hit) => hit || fetch(e.request)));   // cache first
});</pre><ul><li><strong>Strategies:</strong> cache-first for versioned static files, network-first for HTML and data, stale-while-revalidate for things that can be slightly old.</li><li><strong>Updates are the hard part:</strong> the new worker waits until old tabs close (or <code>skipWaiting()</code>); version your cache names and delete old ones on <code>activate</code>.</li><li>It has no DOM access and can be killed at any time, so keep state in caches or IndexedDB. Workbox provides ready-made strategies.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Warn about the failure mode: a buggy service worker can serve stale or broken pages until it is replaced, so ship a kill switch (an updated worker that unregisters itself).</p>`
    },
    {
      q:"Cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB and Cache API: how do they differ?",
      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th>Storage</th><th>Size (roughly)</th><th>Lifetime</th><th>Sent to server</th><th>API</th></tr><tr><td>Cookies</td><td>~4 KB each</td><td>session or until expiry</td><td><strong>yes, every request</strong></td><td>string, sync</td></tr><tr><td><code>localStorage</code></td><td>~5 MB</td><td>until cleared</td><td>no</td><td>key/value strings, synchronous (blocks the main thread)</td></tr><tr><td><code>sessionStorage</code></td><td>~5 MB</td><td>until the tab closes</td><td>no</td><td>same as localStorage, per tab</td></tr><tr><td><code>IndexedDB</code></td><td>large (hundreds of MB, quota based)</td><td>until cleared</td><td>no</td><td>async, structured data, indexes, transactions; works in workers</td></tr><tr><td>Cache API</td><td>large</td><td>until cleared</td><td>no</td><td>stores Request/Response pairs, used by service workers</td></tr></table><ul><li><strong>Nothing here is a safe place for secrets:</strong> any script on the page (XSS) can read <code>localStorage</code> and IndexedDB. Use an <code>HttpOnly</code> cookie for session tokens.</li><li>Use <code>localStorage</code> for small preferences (theme), IndexedDB for offline data and large files, cookies only for what the server must see.</li><li>Data can be evicted under storage pressure; call <code>navigator.storage.persist()</code> for important offline data.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> A senior answer names the trade-offs: synchronous API blocking the main thread, per-origin isolation, private-mode behaviour, and quota errors you must catch.</p>`
    }
  ]

      a:`<p class="lede">An <strong>image</strong> is a read-only, layered template (your app + runtime + dependencies). A <strong>container</strong> is a running instance of an image with its own filesystem, network and process space, sharing the host kernel.</p><pre># Dockerfile: multi-stage build for a Node.js app
FROM node:22-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci                      # cached until package files change
COPY . .
RUN npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev

FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
USER node                       # do not run as root
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]</pre><ul><li><strong>Layer order = cache efficiency:</strong> copy dependency manifests and install first, copy source last, so code edits do not reinstall packages.</li><li><strong>Multi-stage builds</strong> keep compilers and dev dependencies out of the final image: smaller and with a smaller attack surface.</li><li><strong><code>.dockerignore</code></strong> keeps <code>node_modules</code>, <code>.git</code> and secrets out of the build context.</li><li><strong>Never bake secrets into layers:</strong> they stay in image history. Pass them at runtime or use build secrets.</li><li><strong>Containers are ephemeral:</strong> persist data in volumes or external services, log to stdout, handle <code>SIGTERM</code> for graceful shutdown, and add a health check.</li><li><code>EXPOSE</code> only documents a port; <code>-p host:container</code> publishes it. <code>CMD</code> is the default command, <code>ENTRYPOINT</code> the fixed executable.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Image vs container vs volume, and Docker vs a VM (shared kernel, lighter, faster start), are the classic openers.</p>`
    },
    {
      q:"Walk through a CI/CD pipeline and the main rollout strategies.",
      a:`<ol><li><strong>Commit / pull request:</strong> lint, typecheck, unit tests, build (fast, run on every push).</li><li><strong>Merge to main:</strong> integration tests, security scans (dependencies, secrets), build and tag an immutable artifact or image once.</li><li><strong>Deploy to staging:</strong> run migrations, smoke and end-to-end tests against the real artifact.</li><li><strong>Promote the same artifact to production</strong> with a rollout strategy, then watch metrics.</li><li><strong>Rollback or roll forward</strong> quickly if error rate or latency regresses.</li></ol><table class="cmp"><tr><th>Strategy</th><th>How</th><th>Trade-off</th></tr><tr><td>Rolling</td><td>replace instances gradually</td><td>simple; two versions run together for a while</td></tr><tr><td>Blue/green</td><td>switch traffic between two full environments</td><td>instant rollback; double the capacity while switching</td></tr><tr><td>Canary</td><td>send 1%, 10%, 50% of traffic to the new version</td><td>catches problems early; needs good metrics and routing</td></tr><tr><td>Feature flag</td><td>deploy dark, enable per user or percentage</td><td>decouples deploy from release; adds flag debt</td></tr></table><ul><li><strong>Database migrations</strong> must be backward compatible (expand, migrate, contract) so old and new versions can run against the same schema.</li><li><strong>Trunk-based development</strong> (short-lived branches, merge to main often behind flags) keeps integration pain small.</li><li>Keep pipelines fast: cache dependencies, run independent jobs in parallel, run slow end-to-end suites on merge rather than every commit.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Emphasize "build once, deploy the same artifact everywhere" and "every deploy can be rolled back", which are the two rules that prevent most release incidents.</p>`

      q:"What are feature flags, and how do you use them without creating a mess?",
      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th>Type</th><th>Purpose</th><th>Lifetime</th></tr><tr><td>Release flag</td><td>ship code dark, turn on when ready</td><td>short: delete after rollout</td></tr><tr><td>Experiment flag</td><td>A/B test variants</td><td>until the experiment ends</td></tr><tr><td>Ops flag / kill switch</td><td>turn off a heavy or risky feature during an incident</td><td>long-lived</td></tr><tr><td>Permission flag</td><td>entitlements (plan, beta program)</td><td>long-lived</td></tr></table><ul><li><strong>Percentage rollouts</strong> hash a stable id (user id) so a user always gets the same variant (sticky bucketing).</li><li><strong>Evaluate on the server</strong> when the flag hides code or data; client-side flags are visible to users and can flicker at load.</li><li><strong>Default safe:</strong> if the flag service is down, fall back to the known-good behaviour.</li><li><strong>Manage flag debt:</strong> owner and expiry date on each flag, remove the dead branch after full rollout, test both paths in CI.</li><li>Tools: LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, or a simple config table; OpenFeature is a vendor-neutral API.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> The key sentence: "deploy and release are separate decisions"; flags let you deploy at any time and release when the business is ready.</p>`
    },
    {
      q:"Git merge vs rebase: when do you use each?",
      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th></th><th>merge</th><th>rebase</th></tr><tr><td>History</td><td>keeps real history; adds a merge commit</td><td>rewrites your commits on top of the target: a straight line</td></tr><tr><td>Safety</td><td>never rewrites existing commits</td><td>changes commit ids: <strong>never rebase commits others already pulled</strong></td></tr><tr><td>Conflicts</td><td>resolve once</td><td>may resolve once per replayed commit</td></tr><tr><td>Good for</td><td>integrating a finished branch, shared branches</td><td>updating your local feature branch, tidying commits before review</td></tr></table><pre>git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main            # replay my commits on the latest main (my branch only)
git rebase -i HEAD~4              # squash / reword / reorder the last 4 commits
git push --force-with-lease       # update my rewritten branch; refuses if someone else pushed

git merge --no-ff feature         # integrate with an explicit merge commit
git revert <sha>                  # undo a commit on a shared branch by adding a new one
git reflog                        # find lost commits after a bad reset or rebase</pre><ul><li><strong>Squash merge</strong> in the pull-request UI gives one clean commit per feature; <strong>merge commits</strong> keep the branch structure.</li><li>Prefer <code>--force-with-lease</code> over <code>--force</code>: it aborts if the remote has commits you have not seen.</li><li><code>git pull --rebase</code> avoids noisy "Merge branch main into main" commits.</li><li><strong>reset vs revert:</strong> reset moves the branch pointer (local, rewrites), revert adds an inverse commit (safe for shared history).</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> The one rule that shows judgement: rebase private history freely, merge (or revert) shared history.</p>`

Use ICU MessageFormat for plurals and gender: <code>{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}</code>.</li><li><strong>Use the <code>Intl</code> API</strong> for dates, numbers, currency, lists, relative time and plural rules: <code>new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE', { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' })</code>.</li><li><strong>Locale routing and detection:</strong> <code>/fr/...</code> or subdomains, <code>Accept-Language</code> for the first guess, then let the user choose and remember it. Set <code><html lang></code> and <code>hreflang</code> links for SEO.</li><li><strong>Layout:</strong> text expands (German is longer), so avoid fixed widths; support <strong>RTL</strong> with <code>dir="rtl"</code> and logical properties (<code>margin-inline-start</code>, Tailwind <code>ms-4</code> / <code>ps-4</code>).</li><li><strong>Time zones:</strong> store instants in UTC, format in the user's zone; never build date strings by hand.</li><li>Libraries: next-intl, react-i18next, FormatJS (react-intl), i18next.</li></ul><pre>new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }).format(date);
new Intl.PluralRules('en').select(1);                 // 'one'
new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('es').format(-1, 'day');  // 'hace 1 día'</pre><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Distinguish i18n (making the app translatable and locale-aware) from l10n (producing the translations and locale content).</p>`

It sends the verifier when exchanging the code, so a stolen code alone is useless.</li><li><strong>OAuth 2.1</strong> (consolidating the best practices) makes PKCE mandatory for the authorization code flow, requires exact redirect URI matching, removes the Implicit and Resource Owner Password grants, forbids access tokens in URL query strings, and requires refresh tokens for public clients to be sender-constrained or one-time use.</li><li><strong><code>state</code></strong> guards the redirect against CSRF; OIDC's <code>nonce</code> ties the ID token to the login attempt.</li><li><strong>Web apps:</strong> the backend-for-frontend pattern keeps tokens on the server and gives the browser an <code>HttpOnly</code> session cookie, instead of storing tokens in JavaScript.</li><li><strong>Scopes</strong> limit what the token can do; the API still checks permissions per request.</li></ul><table class="cmp"><tr><th>Token</th><th>Audience</th><th>Use</th></tr><tr><td>Access token</td><td>the API</td><td>authorize API calls; short-lived</td></tr><tr><td>ID token (OIDC)</td><td>your app</td><td>who logged in; verify signature, issuer, audience, expiry and nonce</td></tr><tr><td>Refresh token</td><td>the authorization server</td><td>get new access tokens; store securely, rotate</td></tr></table><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Classic mix-up to avoid: an ID token is not for calling APIs, and an access token is not proof of who the user is.</p>`

    {
      q:"WebSockets vs server-sent events vs long polling: which do you choose?",
      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th></th><th>WebSocket</th><th>Server-sent events (SSE)</th><th>Long polling</th></tr><tr><td>Direction</td><td>both ways</td><td>server to client only</td><td>server to client (each response ends the request)</td></tr><tr><td>Protocol</td><td>upgraded HTTP connection, own framing</td><td>plain HTTP, <code>text/event-stream</code></td><td>plain HTTP</td></tr><tr><td>Reconnect</td><td>you implement it</td><td>automatic, with <code>Last-Event-ID</code> and a server <code>retry</code> hint</td><td>client re-requests</td></tr><tr><td>Data</td><td>text or binary</td><td>UTF-8 text</td><td>anything</td></tr><tr><td>Proxies and infra</td><td>needs upgrade support and sticky, long-lived connections</td><td>works through most HTTP infrastructure</td><td>works everywhere</td></tr><tr><td>Good for</td><td>chat, multiplayer, collaborative editing</td><td>notifications, live feeds, progress, AI token streaming</td><td>fallback, very low-frequency updates</td></tr></table><ul><li><strong>SSE over HTTP/1.1</strong> is limited by the browser's ~6 connections per domain across all tabs; over HTTP/2 many streams share one connection.</li><li>If the client only needs to <em>receive</em> updates and sends the occasional action via normal requests, SSE is simpler to run than WebSockets.</li><li><strong>Scaling either:</strong> connections are long-lived and stateful, so use a pub/sub layer (Redis, NATS, Kafka) to deliver events to whichever server holds the user's connection.</li><li>Send heartbeats so proxies do not close idle connections, and plan for reconnect storms after a deploy.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Start from the direction of data: "server pushes only" points to SSE, "both sides talk constantly" points to WebSockets.</p>`

<link rel="preload" href="/fonts/inter.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin>
<img src="/hero.avif" alt="…" width="1200" height="600" fetchpriority="high"></pre><ul><li><strong>Preload is a promise to use the file</strong>: an unused preload wastes bandwidth and the browser warns about it. Set <code>as</code> correctly or it may be downloaded twice.</li><li>Fonts need <code>crossorigin</code> on the preload even from your own origin, because fonts are fetched in CORS mode.</li><li>Too many high-priority hints cancel each other out; pick the one or two things that block the first render.</li><li>Frameworks help: Next.js <code>next/font</code> and the <code>priority</code> prop on <code>next/image</code> emit these hints for you.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> Tie each hint to a Core Web Vital: preconnect and preload the LCP resource for LCP, width and height on images for CLS.</p>`

      q:"How do responsive images work (srcset, sizes, picture, AVIF and WebP)?",

<img
  src="/photo-800.jpg"
  srcset="/photo-400.jpg 400w, /photo-800.jpg 800w, /photo-1600.jpg 1600w"
  sizes="(max-width: 700px) 100vw, 50vw"

</picture></pre><ul><li><code>srcset</code> with <code>w</code> descriptors lists files and their real widths; <code>sizes</code> tells the browser how wide the image will be displayed, so it can choose before layout. Without <code>sizes</code>, it assumes <code>100vw</code> and often downloads too large a file.</li><li><code><picture></code> with <code><source type></code> serves AVIF or WebP to browsers that support them and falls back to JPEG or PNG.</li><li><strong>Always set width and height</strong> (or <code>aspect-ratio</code>) so the browser reserves space and the layout does not shift (CLS).</li><li>Art direction (a different crop on mobile) uses <code><source media="..."></code> inside <code><picture></code>.</li><li>An image CDN or <code>next/image</code> can generate the sizes and formats automatically.</li></ul><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> The most common real bug: a 3000px image scaled down to 300px on mobile. <code>srcset</code> plus <code>sizes</code> fixes it.</p>`

Every header, cookie or query parameter added to the key splits the cache. Normalize or strip irrelevant query strings (tracking parameters), and do not vary on cookies for public pages.</li><li><strong>TTL control:</strong> <code>Cache-Control: s-maxage</code> for the CDN, <code>max-age</code> for browsers, <code>stale-while-revalidate</code> and <code>stale-if-error</code> to serve stale content while refreshing or when the origin is down.</li><li><strong>Invalidation:</strong> prefer <em>versioned URLs</em> for assets (never purge). For HTML and APIs, purge by URL or by <strong>surrogate keys / cache tags</strong> (tag every product page with <code>product-42</code> and purge the tag when it changes).</li><li><strong>Origin shield:</strong> one designated tier fetches from the origin for all edges, so a cache miss storm becomes one origin request.</li><li><strong>Request collapsing:</strong> many simultaneous misses for the same key wait for one origin fetch (prevents a thundering herd).</li><li><strong>More than caching:</strong> TLS termination, HTTP/3, compression, image optimization, WAF, bot and DDoS protection, edge functions for redirects and A/B tests.</li></ul><table class="cmp"><tr><th>Content</th><th>Strategy</th></tr><tr><td>Hashed JS, CSS, fonts</td><td><code>max-age=31536000, immutable</code>; new file name on change</td></tr><tr><td>HTML</td><td>short <code>s-maxage</code> plus <code>stale-while-revalidate</code>, or no CDN caching if personalized</td></tr><tr><td>Public API responses</td><td><code>s-maxage</code> of seconds to minutes, purge by tag on write</td></tr><tr><td>Personalized responses</td><td>do not cache at the CDN (<code>private</code>), or cache the shell and load personal parts client-side</td></tr></table><p><strong>Interview tip:</strong> A good hit ratio comes from a tight cache key; say how you would find what is fragmenting it (CDN analytics by cache key or query string).</p>`

const content = document.getElementById('content');
let activeId = DATA[0].id;
const sidebarEl = document.getElementById('sidebar');
const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
const navToggleLbl = document.getElementById('navToggleLbl');
function closeNav(){ sidebarEl.classList.remove('open'); navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
navToggle.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ const o = sidebarEl.classList.toggle('open'); navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(o)); });
// Sidebar top row: a way back to the list of guides and a light/dark switch. The guide runs in an
// iframe on the site, so the link targets the top window and the switch writes the same `theme`
// key next-themes reads (the site then follows via the storage event).
(function(){
  if(document.querySelector('.side-top')) return;
  const top = document.createElement('div');
  top.className = 'side-top';
  top.innerHTML = '<a class="home-link" href="/" target="_top" aria-label="All guides">←<span> All guides</span></a>' +
    '<button class="theme-btn" type="button" aria-label="Switch between light and dark" title="Light / dark">◐</button>';
  sidebarEl.insertBefore(top, sidebarEl.firstChild);
  top.querySelector('.theme-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const dark = root.getAttribute('data-theme') ? root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' : matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    const next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    try{ localStorage.setItem('theme', next); }catch(e){}
  });
})();

// ---- answer polish: colour code blocks and let wide tables scroll sideways on their own.
// A <pre class="plain"> (prompts, sample output) is never coloured; other blocks only when they look like code.
const CODE_SIGNS = /\b(const|let|var|function|return|import|export|class|interface|type|await|async|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|CREATE|def|func|public|private)\b|=>|===|!==|\(\)\s*\{|;\s*$|<\/?[A-Za-z][\w.-]*[\s>]|^\s*(\$|npm|npx|git|docker|kubectl|curl|node|aws)\s/m;
const TOKEN_RE = /(\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|(?<![:\w])\/\/[^\n]*|(?<=^|\s)#(?=\s|!)[^\n]*)|("(?:\\.|[^"\\\n])*"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\\n])*'|`(?:\\.|[^`\\])*`)|\b(const|let|var|function|return|if|else|for|while|do|switch|case|break|continue|import|from|export|default|class|extends|implements|new|async|await|try|catch|finally|throw|typeof|instanceof|in|of|type|interface|enum|readonly|public|private|protected|static|as|satisfies|keyof|infer|yield|void|null|undefined|true|false|this|super|SELECT|FROM|WHERE|JOIN|LEFT|INNER|ON|GROUP BY|ORDER BY|LIMIT|INSERT|INTO|VALUES|UPDATE|SET|DELETE|CREATE|TABLE|INDEX|BEGIN|COMMIT|AND|OR|NOT)\b|\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\b/gm;
const escCode = (s)=> s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
function colourCode(pre){
  if(pre.dataset.hl || pre.children.length || pre.classList.contains('plain')) return;
  pre.dataset.hl = '1';
  const src = pre.textContent;
  if(src.length > 6000 || !CODE_SIGNS.test(src)) return;
  let out = '', last = 0;
  src.replace(TOKEN_RE, (m, c, str, k, n, at)=>{
    out += escCode(src.slice(last, at)) + '<span class="tk-' + (c ? 'c' : str ? 's' : k ? 'k' : 'n') + '">' + escCode(m) + '</span>';
    last = at + m.length;
    return m;
  });
  pre.innerHTML = out + escCode(src.slice(last));
}
function enhance(root){
  root.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(colourCode);
  root.querySelectorAll('table.cmp').forEach(t=>{
    const p = t.parentElement;
    if(p.classList.contains('tscroll') || /overflow/.test(p.getAttribute('style') || '')) return;
    const w = document.createElement('div'); w.className = 'tscroll';
    p.insertBefore(w, t); w.appendChild(t);
  });
}
const STORAGE_KEY = window.__STUDY__.key + '-reviewed-v1';
const PREFS_KEY = window.__STUDY__.key + '-prefs-v1';

function readJSON(key, fallback){ try{ const raw = localStorage.getItem(key); return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback; }catch(e){ return fallback; } }
function writeJSON(key, val){ try{ localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val)); }catch(e){} }

let reviewed = readJSON(STORAGE_KEY, {});
// Shared progress: the same question in another guide counts as reviewed here too (matched by normalised title).
const TITLES_KEY = 'study-reviewed-titles-v1';
let titleDone = readJSON(TITLES_KEY, {});
const titleKey = (t)=> String(t).replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/&[a-z#0-9]+;/gi,' ').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim();
function syncTitle(sid, idx, val){
  const e = INDEX.find(x=>x.section.id===sid && x.qIdx===idx);
  if(!e) return;
  if(val) titleDone[e.tkey] = 1; else delete titleDone[e.tkey];
  writeJSON(TITLES_KEY, titleDone);
}
// Weak cards: shared across guides the same way (by title), so a card you keep missing on one
// guide shows up as weak everywhere it appears. "Again" in flashcards adds it; "Got it" clears it.
const WEAK_KEY = 'study-weak-titles-v1';
let weak = readJSON(WEAK_KEY, {});
function markWeak(tkey, isWeak){ if(isWeak) weak[tkey] = (weak[tkey]||0) + 1; else delete weak[tkey]; writeJSON(WEAK_KEY, weak); }
let prefs = Object.assign({ summaries:true, coreOnly:false, hideDone:false, shuffle:false }, readJSON(PREFS_KEY, {}));
function savePrefs(){ writeJSON(PREFS_KEY, prefs); }
function qKey(sectionId, qIdx){ return sectionId + ':' + qIdx; }

// ---- derived data: plain text, one-line summaries, core set, reading time
const stripTags = (s)=> s.replace(/<pre[\s\S]*?<\/pre>/g,' ').replace(/<svg[\s\S]*?<\/svg>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ')
  .replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/—/g,'—').replace(/→/g,'→').replace(/&[a-z]+;/g,' ')
  .replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
const INDEX = [];
DATA.forEach(section=>{
  section.questions.forEach((item, qIdx)=>{
    // Summary: leading prose (no badges, tables, code or diagrams), whole sentences until it says something useful.
    const prose = stripTags(item.a.replace(/<span class="tbadge">[\s\S]*?<\/span>/,'').replace(/<table[\s\S]*?<\/table>/g,' ').replace(/<div class="diagram">[\s\S]*?<\/div>/g,' '));
    const sentences = prose.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z0-9"'(])/);
    let summary = '';
    for(const s of sentences){ if(summary.length >= 90) break; summary = (summary ? summary + ' ' : '') + s; }
    summary = summary.replace(/^(Common follow-ups|Model answer:|Answer:)\s*/i, '');
    if(summary.length > 240) summary = summary.slice(0, 237).replace(/\s+\S*$/,'') + '…';
    const text = stripTags(item.q + ' ' + item.a);
    INDEX.push({ section, qIdx, item, summary, text: text.toLowerCase(), words: text.split(' ').length });
  });
});
let migrated = false;
INDEX.forEach(e=>{
  e.tkey = titleKey(e.item.q);
  const k = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx);
  if(titleDone[e.tkey]) reviewed[k] = true;
  else if(reviewed[k]){ titleDone[e.tkey] = 1; migrated = true; }   // progress made before shared progress existed
});
if(migrated) writeJSON(TITLES_KEY, titleDone);
const CORE = new Set();
const review = DATA.find(s=>s.id==='review');
if(review) review.questions.forEach(q=>{ (q.a.match(/data-go="[^"]+"/g)||[]).forEach(m=>CORE.add(m.slice(9,-1))); });
const entry = (sid, i)=> INDEX.find(e=>e.section.id===sid && e.qIdx===i);
function minutes(words){ return Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 200)); }

// ---- totals and progress
function totalQuestions(){ return INDEX.length; }
function reviewedCount(){ return INDEX.filter(e=>reviewed[qKey(e.section.id,e.qIdx)]).length; }
function sectionDone(section){ return section.questions.filter((_,i)=>reviewed[qKey(section.id,i)]).length; }
function updateProgress(){
  const total = totalQuestions(), done = reviewedCount();
  document.getElementById('progressNum').textContent = done + ' / ' + total;
  document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = (total ? (done/total*100) : 0) + '%';
}

// ---- nav
function renderNav(){
  navList.innerHTML = '';
  const curIdx = DATA.findIndex(s=>s.id===activeId);
  navToggleLbl.textContent = searchTerm ? 'Search results' : String(curIdx+1).padStart(2,'0') + ' · ' + DATA[curIdx].title.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'');
  DATA.forEach((section, idx)=>{
    const done = sectionDone(section), total = section.questions.length;
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'nav-item' + (section.id===activeId && !searchTerm ? ' active':'') + (done===total ? ' complete':'');
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="nav-num">' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span><span class="nav-label">' + section.title + '</span><span class="nav-count" title="' + done + ' of ' + total + ' reviewed">' + (done ? done + '/' : '') + total + '</span>';
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeNav(); clearSearch(false); activeId = section.id; hideBack(); renderNav(); renderContent(); window.scrollTo(0,0); });
    navList.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

// ---- cards
function highlight(html, terms){
  if(!terms.length) return html;
  let out = html;
  terms.forEach(t=>{
    const safe = t.replace(/[.*+?^$(){}|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&');
    out = out.replace(new RegExp('(^|>)([^<]*)', 'g'), (m, a, b)=> a + b.replace(new RegExp('(' + safe + ')', 'ig'), '<mark>$1</mark>'));
  });
  return out;
}
function buildCard(e, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const key = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx);
  const isDone = !!reviewed[key];
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'qcard' + (opts.open ? ' open' : '');
  card.dataset.q = e.qIdx;
  card.dataset.sec = e.section.id;
  const core = CORE.has(key);
  const chips = (opts.showSection ? '<span class="qsec">' + e.section.title + '</span>' : '') + (core ? '<span class="qcore" title="Core: linked from ' + window.__STUDY__.core + '">★ core</span>' : '');
  const showSummary = prefs.summaries && e.section.id !== 'review' && e.summary;
  const qhead = document.createElement('div');
  qhead.className = 'qhead';
  qhead.innerHTML =
    '<span class="qcheck ' + (isDone?'done':'') + '" role="checkbox" aria-checked="' + isDone + '" tabindex="0" title="Mark reviewed (x)"></span>' +
    '<span class="qmain"><span class="qtext ' + (isDone?'done-text':'') + '">' + highlight(e.item.q, opts.terms || []) + '</span>' +
    (chips ? '<span class="qchips">' + chips + '</span>' : '') +
    (showSummary ? '<span class="qsum">' + highlight(e.summary.replace(/</g,'<'), opts.terms || []) + '</span>' : '') + '</span>' +
    '<span class="qchevron">›</span>';
  const checkEl = qhead.querySelector('.qcheck');
  const toggleDone = (ev)=>{ ev.stopPropagation(); setDone(card, !reviewed[key]); };
  checkEl.addEventListener('click', toggleDone);
  checkEl.addEventListener('keydown', (ev)=>{ if(ev.key===' '||ev.key==='Enter'){ ev.preventDefault(); toggleDone(ev); } });
  qhead.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ card.classList.toggle('open'); setFocus(card, false); });
  const body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'qbody';
  body.innerHTML = e.item.a;
  enhance(body);
  card.appendChild(qhead);
  card.appendChild(body);
  return card;
}
function setDone(card, val){
  const key = qKey(card.dataset.sec, Number(card.dataset.q));
  reviewed[key] = val;
  writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed);
  syncTitle(card.dataset.sec, Number(card.dataset.q), val);
  const c = card.querySelector('.qcheck'), t = card.querySelector('.qtext');
  c.classList.toggle('done', val); c.setAttribute('aria-checked', val); t.classList.toggle('done-text', val);
  updateProgress(); renderNav();
}

// ---- section view
function toolbarHTML(section, shown){
  const words = section.questions.reduce((n,_,i)=> n + entry(section.id,i).words, 0);
  const coreN = section.questions.filter((_,i)=>CORE.has(qKey(section.id,i))).length;
  return '<div class="toolbar">' +
    '<span class="tmeta">~' + minutes(words) + ' min full read' + (coreN && section.id!=='review' ? ' · ' + coreN + ' core' : '') + (shown !== section.questions.length ? ' · showing ' + shown : '') + '</span>' +
    '<span class="tgroup"><button data-act="flash" class="flash-btn">▶ Flashcards</button><button data-act="expand">Expand all</button><button data-act="collapse">Collapse all</button></span>' +
    '<span class="tgroup">' +
      '<label><input type="checkbox" data-pref="summaries"' + (prefs.summaries?' checked':'') + '> Summaries</label>' +
      (CORE.size ? '<label><input type="checkbox" data-pref="coreOnly"' + (prefs.coreOnly?' checked':'') + '> ★ Core only</label>' : '') +
      '<label><input type="checkbox" data-pref="hideDone"' + (prefs.hideDone?' checked':'') + '> Hide reviewed</label>' +
    '</span></div>';
}
function renderContent(forceIdx){
  content.innerHTML = '';
  const section = DATA.find(s=>s.id===activeId);
  const idx = DATA.findIndex(s=>s.id===activeId);
  const visible = section.questions.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>{
    if(i === forceIdx || section.id === 'review') return true;
    const key = qKey(section.id, i);
    if(prefs.coreOnly && !CORE.has(key)) return false;
    if(prefs.hideDone && reviewed[key]) return false;
    return true;
  });
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'section-head';
  head.innerHTML = '<span class="num">' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span><h2>' + section.title + '</h2><span class="count">' + sectionDone(section) + ' / ' + section.questions.length + ' reviewed</span>';
  content.appendChild(head);
  const tb = document.createElement('div');
  tb.innerHTML = toolbarHTML(section, visible.length);
  content.appendChild(tb.firstChild);
  if(!visible.length){
    const empty = document.createElement('p');
    empty.className = 'empty';
    empty.textContent = prefs.coreOnly ? 'No core questions in this section with the current filters. Untick "Core only" to see all.' : 'Everything here is reviewed. Untick "Hide reviewed" to see it again.';
    content.appendChild(empty);
  }
  visible.forEach(i=> content.appendChild(buildCard(entry(section.id, i), { open: section.id === 'review' || !!window.__STUDY__.openAll })));
  const pager = document.createElement('div');
  pager.className = 'pager';
  const prev = DATA[idx-1], next = DATA[idx+1];
  pager.innerHTML = (prev ? '<button data-goto="' + prev.id + '">← ' + prev.title + '</button>' : '<span></span>') + (next ? '<button data-goto="' + next.id + '">' + next.title + ' →</button>' : '<span></span>');
  content.appendChild(pager);
  focusIdx = -1;
}

// ---- search
let searchTerm = '';
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
function renderSearch(){
  const terms = searchTerm.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(t=>t.length > 1);
  const hits = INDEX.filter(e=> terms.every(t=> e.text.includes(t)))
    .map(e=>({ e, score: terms.reduce((n,t)=> n + (e.item.q.toLowerCase().includes(t) ? 10 : 1), 0) }))
    .sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score);
  content.innerHTML = '';
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'section-head';
  head.innerHTML = '<span class="num">⌕</span><h2>Search</h2><span class="count">' + hits.length + ' result' + (hits.length===1?'':'s') + '</span>';
  content.appendChild(head);
  if(hits.length){
    const tb = document.createElement('div'); tb.className = 'toolbar';
    tb.innerHTML = '<span class="tmeta">' + (hits.length > 80 ? 'showing the top 80' : 'best matches first') + '</span><span class="tgroup"><button data-act="flash" class="flash-btn">▶ Flashcards from these results</button></span>';
    content.appendChild(tb);
  }
  if(!hits.length){
    const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'empty'; p.textContent = 'No questions in this guide match "' + searchTerm + '". Try fewer or shorter words.'; content.appendChild(p);
  }
  hits.slice(0, 80).forEach(h=> content.appendChild(buildCard(h.e, { showSection:true, terms })));
  const gb = document.createElement('div'); gb.id = 'globalHits'; gb.className = 'ghits'; content.appendChild(gb);
  if(GLOBAL) fillGlobal(); else { gb.innerHTML = '<p class="gh-note">Searching the other guides…</p>'; loadGlobal(); }
  focusIdx = -1;
  renderNav();
}
// Other guides: /search-index.json is generated from every guide (items: [page, sectionId, qIdx, sectionTitle, question, summary]).
const PAGE_SLUG = location.pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g,'').split('/')[0] || '';
const PRIORITY = { 'interview-prep': 2, 'system-design': 1, 'react-training': 1 };   // if several guides carry a question, link the most specific one
const escH = (s)=> String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
let GLOBAL = null, globalLoading = false;
function loadGlobal(){
  if(GLOBAL || globalLoading) return;
  globalLoading = true;
  fetch('/search-index.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>{ GLOBAL = j; fillGlobal(); }).catch(()=>{ globalLoading = false; const b = document.getElementById('globalHits'); if(b) b.innerHTML = ''; });
}
function fillGlobal(){
  const box = document.getElementById('globalHits');
  if(!box || !GLOBAL) return;
  const terms = searchTerm.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(t=>t.length > 1);
  if(!terms.length){ box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const local = new Set(INDEX.map(e=>e.tkey));
  const best = new Map();
  GLOBAL.items.forEach(it=>{
    const p = it[0], sid = it[1], qi = it[2], st = it[3], qt = it[4], sum = it[5];
    if(p === PAGE_SLUG) return;
    const tk = titleKey(qt);
    if(local.has(tk)) return;
    const hay = (qt + ' ' + st + ' ' + sum).toLowerCase();
    if(!terms.every(t=> hay.includes(t))) return;
    const score = terms.reduce((n,t)=> n + (qt.toLowerCase().includes(t) ? 10 : 1), 0);
    const prev = best.get(tk);
    if(!prev || (PRIORITY[p]||0) < (PRIORITY[prev.p]||0)) best.set(tk, { p, sid, qi, st, qt, sum, score });
  });
  const all = Array.from(best.values()).sort((a,b)=> b.score - a.score || (PRIORITY[a.p]||0) - (PRIORITY[b.p]||0));
  const list = all.slice(0, 12);
  box.innerHTML = list.length
    ? '<h3 class="gh-head"><span>Also in other guides</span><span>' + (all.length > list.length ? 'top ' + list.length + ' of ' + all.length : all.length) + '</span></h3>' +
      list.map(r=> '<a class="gh" href="/' + r.p + '#' + r.sid + ':' + r.qi + '" target="_top"><span class="gh-t">' + highlight(escH(r.qt), terms) + '</span><span class="gh-m">' + escH(GLOBAL.pages[r.p] || r.p) + ' · ' + escH(r.st) + '</span><span class="gh-s">' + escH(r.sum) + '</span></a>').join('')
    : '';
}
let searchTimer;
searchInput.addEventListener('focus', closeNav);
searchInput.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
  clearTimeout(searchTimer);
  searchTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
    searchTerm = searchInput.value.trim();
    if(searchTerm.length >= 2){ hideBack(); renderSearch(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }
    else if(!searchTerm){ renderNav(); renderContent(); }
  }, 140);
});
function clearSearch(rerender){
  if(!searchTerm && !searchInput.value) return;
  searchTerm = ''; searchInput.value = '';
  if(rerender !== false){ renderNav(); renderContent(); }
}

// ---- navigation between questions, with a Back button
const backBtn = document.getElementById('backBtn');
let returnTo = null;
function hideBack(){ returnTo = null; backBtn.hidden = true; }
function gotoQuestion(id, qIdx, fromLink){
  if(!DATA.find(s=>s.id===id)) return;
  const n0 = (qIdx !== undefined && !isNaN(qIdx)) ? qIdx : undefined;
  // The #section deep link retries its message for a few seconds in case the page was still
  // loading; once we're already showing the target, ignore the repeats instead of re-rendering
  // and re-scrolling under the user every time one arrives.
  if(!fromLink && activeId === id && (n0 === undefined || content.querySelector('.qcard[data-q="' + n0 + '"]')?.classList.contains('open'))) return;
  closeNav();
  if(fromLink){
    returnTo = { id: activeId, search: searchTerm, y: window.scrollY };
    const from = searchTerm ? 'search' : DATA.find(s=>s.id===activeId).title;
    backBtn.textContent = '← Back to ' + from;
    backBtn.hidden = false;
  }
  searchTerm = ''; searchInput.value = '';
  activeId = id;
  const n = (qIdx !== undefined && !isNaN(qIdx)) ? qIdx : undefined;
  renderNav();
  renderContent(n);
  const card = n !== undefined ? content.querySelector('.qcard[data-q="' + n + '"]') : null;
  if(card){ card.classList.add('open'); setFocus(card, true); }
  else window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
backBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(!returnTo) return;
  const r = returnTo; hideBack();
  if(r.search){ searchTerm = r.search; searchInput.value = r.search; renderSearch(); }
  else { activeId = r.id; renderNav(); renderContent(); }
  requestAnimationFrame(()=> window.scrollTo(0, r.y));
});
window.addEventListener('message', (e)=>{
  if(!e.data) return;
  if(e.data.type==='goto-section') gotoQuestion(e.data.id, e.data.qIdx, false);
  else if(e.data.type==='start-weak-deck') startWeakDeck();
});
content.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  const a = e.target.closest('a[data-go]');
  if(a){ e.preventDefault(); const [id, q] = a.dataset.go.split(':'); gotoQuestion(id, Number(q), true); return; }
  const g = e.target.closest('button[data-goto]');
  if(g){ activeId = g.dataset.goto; hideBack(); renderNav(); renderContent(); window.scrollTo(0,0); return; }
  const act = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
  if(act){
    if(act.dataset.act === 'flash'){ startDeck(deckFromView(), searchTerm ? 'Search: ' + searchTerm : DATA.find(s=>s.id===activeId).title); return; }
    content.querySelectorAll('.qcard').forEach(c=> c.classList.toggle('open', act.dataset.act === 'expand'));
  }
});
content.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  const p = e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.pref;
  if(!p) return;
  prefs[p] = e.target.checked; savePrefs();
  if(searchTerm) renderSearch(); else renderContent();
});

// ---- keyboard: / search, j/k move, o or Enter open, x reviewed, n/p section, Esc
let focusIdx = -1;
function cards(){ return Array.from(content.querySelectorAll('.qcard')); }
function setFocus(card, scroll){
  cards().forEach(c=> c.classList.remove('focused'));
  card.classList.add('focused');
  focusIdx = cards().indexOf(card);
  if(scroll) card.scrollIntoView({ block:'start', behavior:'smooth' });
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(fc.open){ fcKey(e); return; }
  if((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k'){ e.preventDefault(); closeNav(); searchInput.focus(); searchInput.select(); return; }
  const typing = /INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(document.activeElement.tagName);
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ if(searchTerm || searchInput.value){ clearSearch(); } searchInput.blur(); return; }
  if(typing || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
  const list = cards();
  if(e.key === '/'){ e.preventDefault(); searchInput.focus(); searchInput.select(); return; }
  if(e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'k'){
    if(!list.length) return;
    focusIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, focusIdx + (e.key === 'j' ? 1 : -1)));
    setFocus(list[focusIdx], true); return;
  }
  const cur = list[focusIdx];
  if((e.key === 'o' || e.key === 'Enter') && cur){ cur.classList.toggle('open'); return; }
  if(e.key === 'x' && cur){ setDone(cur, !reviewed[qKey(cur.dataset.sec, Number(cur.dataset.q))]); return; }
  if(e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'p'){
    if(searchTerm) return;
    const i = DATA.findIndex(s=>s.id===activeId) + (e.key === 'n' ? 1 : -1);
    if(DATA[i]){ activeId = DATA[i].id; hideBack(); renderNav(); renderContent(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }
  }
});


// ---- flashcards: question first, say the answer, reveal, rate yourself
const fcEl = document.getElementById('fc');
const fc = { open:false, deck:[], i:0, revealed:false, got:0, missed:[], again:new Map(), title:'', source:[] };
function shuffleArr(a){ for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); const t=a[i]; a[i]=a[j]; a[j]=t; } return a; }
function startDeck(entries, title){
  if(!entries.length) return;
  fc.source = entries.slice();
  fc.deck = prefs.shuffle ? shuffleArr(entries.slice()) : entries.slice();
  fc.i = 0; fc.revealed = false; fc.got = 0; fc.missed = []; fc.again = new Map(); fc.title = title; fc.open = true;
  fc.opener = document.activeElement;   // restore focus here when the dialog closes
  fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').checked = !!prefs.shuffle;
  fcEl.hidden = false; document.body.classList.add('fc-lock');
  renderFc();
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-dialog').focus();
}
function closeFc(){
  fc.open = false; fcEl.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove('fc-lock');
  refreshWeakButton();
  const opener = fc.opener; fc.opener = null;
  if(searchTerm) renderSearch(); else renderContent();   // rebuilds #content, so `opener` may now be a detached node
  // Return focus to whatever opened the deck when it's still on the page (the hero "Flashcards"
  // buttons, outside #content, always survive this). Otherwise #content was just rebuilt under
  // the (now-detached) opener, so land on its heading instead of silently losing focus to <body>.
  if(opener && document.contains(opener)) opener.focus();
  else {
    const heading = content.querySelector('.section-head h2') || content.querySelector('.section-head');
    if(heading){ heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); heading.focus(); }
  }
}
function markReviewed(key, val){ reviewed[key] = val; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed); const p = key.split(':'); syncTitle(p[0], Number(p[1]), val); updateProgress(); renderNav(); }
function renderFc(){
  const n = fc.deck.length;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-title').textContent = fc.title;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-count').textContent = (fc.i < n ? (fc.i + 1) : n) + ' / ' + n + (fc.got ? ' · ' + fc.got + ' got it' : '') + (fc.missed.length ? ' · ' + new Set(fc.missed).size + ' to revisit' : '');
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-bar i').style.width = (n ? fc.i / n * 100 : 0) + '%';
  const body = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-body');
  const actions = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-actions');
  if(fc.i >= n){
    const uniqMissed = Array.from(new Set(fc.missed));
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-done"><h3>Deck finished</h3><p>' + fc.got + ' marked "got it" (and ticked as reviewed) · ' + uniqMissed.length + ' to revisit.</p>' +
      (uniqMissed.length ? '<p class="fc-sub">To revisit:</p><ul>' + uniqMissed.map(e=>'<li>' + e.item.q + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="fc-sub">Nothing missed. Well done.</p>') + '</div>';
    actions.innerHTML = (uniqMissed.length ? '<button data-fc="missed" class="primary">Practise the ' + uniqMissed.length + ' missed</button>' : '') +
      '<button data-fc="restart">Restart deck</button><button data-fc="close">Close <kbd>Esc</kbd></button>';
    return;
  }
  const e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  const key = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx);
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="qchips"><span class="qsec">' + e.section.title + '</span>' + (CORE.has(key) ? '<span class="qcore">★ core</span>' : '') + (reviewed[key] ? '<span class="qsec">reviewed</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
    '<h3 class="fc-q">' + e.item.q + '</h3>' +
    (fc.revealed ? '<div class="qbody fc-a">' + e.item.a + '</div>' : '<p class="fc-prompt">Answer it out loud first: the main point, one example, one trade-off. Then reveal.</p>');
  enhance(body);
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  actions.innerHTML = fc.revealed
    ? '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="again" class="again">Again <kbd>1</kbd></button><button data-fc="got" class="primary">Got it <kbd>2</kbd></button>'
    : '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="reveal" class="primary">Reveal answer <kbd>Space</kbd></button><button data-fc="skip">Skip <kbd>→</kbd></button>';
}
function fcAction(act){
  const n = fc.deck.length, e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  if(act === 'close') return closeFc();
  if(act === 'restart') return startDeck(fc.source, fc.title);
  if(act === 'missed') return startDeck(Array.from(new Set(fc.missed)), fc.title + ' · missed');
  if(fc.i >= n && act !== 'prev') return;
  if(act === 'reveal'){ fc.revealed = !fc.revealed; }
  else if(act === 'got'){ if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; } else { markReviewed(qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), true); markWeak(e.tkey, false); fc.got++; fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; } }
  else if(act === 'again'){
    if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; }
    else {
      const k = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), times = fc.again.get(k) || 0;
      fc.missed.push(e);
      markWeak(e.tkey, true);
      if(times < 2){ fc.deck.push(e); fc.again.set(k, times + 1); }   // comes back later in this session
      fc.i++; fc.revealed = false;
    }
  }
  else if(act === 'skip'){ fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; }
  else if(act === 'prev'){ if(fc.i > 0){ fc.i--; fc.revealed = false; } }
  renderFc();
}
fcEl.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  if(e.target === fcEl) return closeFc();
  const b = e.target.closest('button[data-fc]');
  if(b) return fcAction(b.dataset.fc);
  const a = e.target.closest('a[data-go]');
  if(a){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); const p = a.dataset.go.split(':'); gotoQuestion(p[0], Number(p[1]), true); }
});
fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  prefs.shuffle = e.target.checked; savePrefs();
  const keep = fc.i + (fc.revealed ? 1 : 0);
  const rest = fc.deck.slice(keep);
  if(prefs.shuffle) shuffleArr(rest);
  fc.deck = fc.deck.slice(0, keep).concat(rest);
  renderFc();
});
function fcFocusables(){
  return Array.from(fcEl.querySelectorAll('button, input, a[href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')).filter((el) => !el.disabled && el.offsetParent !== null);
}
function fcKey(e){
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); return; }
  if(e.key === 'Tab'){
    // trap focus inside the dialog: wrap from the last focusable back to the first, and vice versa
    const items = fcFocusables();
    if(!items.length) return;
    const idx = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    const next = e.shiftKey ? (idx <= 0 ? items.length - 1 : idx - 1) : (idx === items.length - 1 ? 0 : idx + 1);
    e.preventDefault();
    items[next].focus();
    return;
  }
  if(e.target && e.target.id === 'fcShuffle') return;
  const map = { ' ':'reveal', 'Enter':'reveal', '1':'again', '2':'got', 'ArrowRight':'skip', 'ArrowLeft':'prev' };
  const act = map[e.key];
  if(!act) return;
  if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) return;   // let a focused button click itself
  e.preventDefault();
  if(fc.i >= fc.deck.length && act !== 'prev') return;
  fcAction(act);
}
function deckFromView(){ return cards().map(c=> entry(c.dataset.sec, Number(c.dataset.q))); }
document.getElementById('fcCore').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(CORE.size) startDeck(Array.from(CORE).map(k=>{ const p = k.split(':'); return entry(p[0], Number(p[1])); }).filter(Boolean), 'All ★ core questions');
  else startDeck(INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref'), 'All questions');
});

// ---- weak cards: any card marked "Again" (anywhere, including another guide), still unresolved
const fcWeakBtn = document.getElementById('fcWeak');
function weakOnThisGuide(){ return INDEX.filter(e=> weak[e.tkey]); }
function refreshWeakButton(){
  if(!fcWeakBtn) return;
  const n = weakOnThisGuide().length;
  fcWeakBtn.hidden = n === 0;
  fcWeakBtn.textContent = '↻ Review ' + n + ' weak card' + (n===1?'':'s');
}
function startWeakDeck(){
  if(fc.open) return;   // the #weak deep link retries its message for a few seconds; ignore repeats once the deck is open, or every retry would reset the user's progress in it
  const list = weakOnThisGuide();
  if(list.length) startDeck(list, 'Weak cards');
}
if(fcWeakBtn) fcWeakBtn.addEventListener('click', startWeakDeck);
refreshWeakButton();
window.addEventListener('storage', (e)=>{ if(e.key === WEAK_KEY){ weak = readJSON(WEAK_KEY, {}); refreshWeakButton(); } });

document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(!confirm('Clear all reviewed checkmarks?')) return;
  reviewed = {}; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed);
  INDEX.forEach(e=>{ delete titleDone[e.tkey]; }); writeJSON(TITLES_KEY, titleDone);
  renderNav(); renderContent(); updateProgress();
});

document.getElementById('heroMeta').textContent = DATA.length + ' sections · ' + totalQuestions() + ' questions' + (CORE.size ? ' · ' + CORE.size + ' marked ★ core (linked from ' + window.__STUDY__.core + ')' : '');
document.getElementById('fcCore').textContent = CORE.size ? '▶ Flashcards: all ★ core questions' : '▶ Flashcards: all ' + INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref').length + ' questions';
renderNav();
renderContent();
updateProgress();
</script>
